book.aerospace.manual.page0:
Aerospace Program
FLIGHT MANUAL

Everything a new astronaut needs to reach the stars.
book.aerospace.manual.page1:
1. LANDING PAD
Craft one from yellow and black concrete, smooth stone and a redstone lamp. Right click the ground with it to build a pad.

2. ROCKET
4 iron blocks, glass, a lightning rod and a blast furnace.
book.aerospace.manual.page2:
3. PLACE IT
Right click the middle of a pad with the Rocket. Right click the Rocket to open its panel.

4. FUEL
Copper, 2 coal, gunpowder and blaze powder make 2 Rocket Fuel. Load it in the panel.
book.aerospace.manual.page3:
5. LAUNCH
Pick a world and press Launch. The rocket lands on a new pad, so you can fly back.

Trips cost 1 to 4 fuel. Launching needs cheats allowed in the world.
book.aerospace.manual.page4:
6. WORLDS
The Moon pulls a sixth as hard as Earth, Mars a third: jump higher, fall slower. The Moon and the Asteroid Belt have no air, so wear a Space Helmet.
book.aerospace.manual.page5:
7. DANGER
Every world hides ruins with spawners, loot and a boss: the Outpost Overseer, Martian Warlord, Frost Lich, Magma Tyrant and Station Warden.

Good luck.
